data.long_meaning: The meaning of Bacchus is recorded in name-lists as “God of Wine and Fertility”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bacchus expresses “God of Wine and Fertility”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bacchus total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: יוֹד-הֶה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name 'Bacchus' does not have a direct equivalent in Hebrew, as it is a name originating from Greek mythology. However, the meaning of 'Bacchus' - 'God of Joy' - can be translated to 'יוֹד (יוֹדה) - הֶה (הוֹה)' which means 'God of Joy' in Hebrew, using the Hebrew roots for 'God' and 'Joy'.

in_greek.name: Βάκχος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name 'Bacchus' in Greek means 'Βάκχος (Βάκχος)' which can be translated to 'Loud-Mouthed, Roaring' from the Greek roots 'Βάκχος' and 'Στόμα'.

in_latin.name: Bacchus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name 'Bacchus' in Latin means 'Bacchus (Bacchus)' which can be translated to 'Free, Unrestrained' from the Latin root 'Liber'.
